Reinterpret the authored SVG references faithfully as REAL photographed equipment, physical classroom models and PRINTED physical evidence displays on cream or clear acrylic boards. Real camera optics, convincing material texture, soft natural or appropriate laboratory light. No flat SVG/cartoon appearance. Diagrams that cannot literally be photographed (atoms, particles, energy charts, reaction equations, spectra) must be presented as a clearly physical teaching model or printed card/monitor display in the photograph. A printed display can faithfully preserve reference geometry and lettering. No invented scale marks or numbers on glass or instruments. Do not copy the final all-caps footer, because the app displays it separately. Keep ALL essential apparatus and readable evidence inside each tile's central 88% width and central 75% height, with generous quiet margins, so cropping to a panoramic 1280x480 banner loses nothing. Use large legible printed text with ample spacing. No people, logos, watermarks or title outside the atlas. Never leak an adjacent tile into a photograph.
